title: connector-rest: a baseUrl that carries a query string puts the request path inside the query (buildUrl joins base + path as text)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named location.** `reach:` a real producer: the dogfood pin `connector-meta-door-entry-and-url-hardening.dogfood.test.ts` (PR #28688) dispatches with an empty path specifically to avoid this. The contract review of #28688 (comment 6560432824, ③ 5) confirmed it from the code. Not measured at a public door with a path-bearing action.
Business reason: a REST connector whose `baseUrl` carries a fixed query parameter (`?region=eu`, `?api-version=2024-01`, a common provider pattern) sends every path-bearing action to the wrong URL. The request goes to the base resource with a malformed query, so the author sees provider 404s or wrong data with no hint why.
Reader: the `connector-rest` owner (`packages/connectors/connector-rest`), one small PR with a unit test.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "buildUrl baseUrl query" → 0 hits; "connector-rest buildUrl" → 1 hit (#20590, closed; a different topic).
⛔ Not a claim.

## Where

`packages/connectors/connector-rest/src/rest-connector.ts`, `buildUrl` (around line 104 on `main`):

```ts
const base = baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
const suffix = path ? (path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`) : '';
const url = new URL(base + suffix);
```

With `baseUrl = 'https://api.example.com/v1?region=eu'` and `path = '/items'`, the text join gives `https://api.example.com/v1?region=eu/items`. The path becomes part of the `region` value, and the request goes to `/v1`.

## Expected

Parse the base first, append the path to `url.pathname` (one slash between), keep the base's own query parameters, then merge the action's `query` (the action's value wins on a clash, or the clash is refused; say which). A unit test should cover a base with a query plus a path, a base with a trailing slash, and an empty path.
